# MM0 source pin

The successful MM0 conversion used the CC0 MM0 project from
[`digama0/mm0`](https://github.com/digama0/mm0) at commit
`697060e119ab3f4f1a8dae4451f5cbacd9803626`.

`LICENSE.txt` is the exact retained upstream notice: 6,671 bytes, SHA-256
`4D2EEF679D5FAF924534BCC132646322E9A852CE50AE5616694E0B95F7B8275D`.
The source revision is pinned rather than vendoring platform binaries. In
particular, the historical Haskell Stack executable and its unrelated runtime
payload are not part of this repository.
